<infobox theme="Language">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Linguistic information</header>
        <data source="users"><label>Users</label></data>
        <data source="locations"><label>Locations</label></data>	
        <data source="script"><label>Script</label></data>	
        <data source="dialects"><label>Dialects</label></data>			
        <data source="characteristics"><label>Characteristics</label></data>
        <data source="related"><label>Related languages</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Language|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

[[Category:infobox templates]]

==Data fields==
*image - a picture of the language, primarily relevant for writing systems
*name - the name of the language
*users - species or groups who speak the language
*locations - areas where the language is widely spoken
*script - an associated writing system
*dialects - dialects of the language
*characteristics - unique characteristics of the language
*related - related languages
</noinclude>
